subject: Vector connector governance & ops onramp
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@pinecone.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Zhou <eric@atlasdata.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vector connector governance & ops onramp

Hi Avery —

Great catching up on Tuesday. Following our discussion, Pinecone is keen to move from discovery to a lightweight certification and ops onramp with Redwood so we can offer an officially supported connector in Q3. Outlined below is what we typically validate for partners (we attached a short checklist):

- Security: SOC2 Type II report, SSO/SAML support, and documented key handling (KMS/HSM)
- Networking: VPC peering options, egress patterns, and IP allowlist procedures
- Data residency: regional hosting guarantees for EU/US customers
- Ops & SLOs: cold-start latency norms, sustained QPS targets, and runbook for incidents
- Integration: schema mapping guide, shard/partition guidance for embeddings, and chunking recommendations
- Billing & commercial: cost-per-1M-embed estimate and suggested rev-share model for co-sell cases

If this aligns, we propose a 4-week onramp plan: week 1 technical intake and test account, week 2 integration testing (end-to-end), week 3 perf soak & security validation, week 4 joint docs + internal enablement.

Attached: pinecone-integration-checklist.pdf and perf-sla-targets.xlsx (stubs).

Can you confirm Redwood's required artifacts and whether you want Pinecone to sign an NDA/POC SOW? Happy to set a standing 30-minute weekly sync.

Best,
Sara Lim
Partner Engineering, Pinecone
[sara@pinecone.io]

--
Attachment: pinecone-integration-checklist.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: perf-sla-targets.xlsx (Excel)
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@pinecone.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vector connector governance & ops onramp

Sara — thanks for the clear checklist. This looks like the right scope. A few Redwood-specific items to add so we can align teams and legal early: 

1) Security artifacts we need before any production sign-off:
   - Current SOC2 report + last 12-months penetration test summary
   - SSO / SAML metadata and a test IdP we can use in staging
   - KMS integration doc: whether Pinecone supports customer-managed keys (CMK) or only provider keys

2) Perf targets we want to validate in week 3:
   - 99p latency for 1–512 token recalls under baseline batch sizing <= 50ms for vector-only recency lookups
   - Sustained 50k QPS across a 6-hour soak (we can scale the test if needed)

3) Ops and runbooks: include automatic fallback behavior if a storage region is unreachable (e.g., read-only spillover to another tier), plus explicit backpressure semantics.

4) Commercial handoff asks: explicit per-region egress costs and a draft SOW with rev-share tiers. Legal will want a simple template we can reuse.

We can commit resources from Redwood Eng (Vanessa) and Partner Ops (Ben) for the intake. Proposed timeslot for weekly sync: Tuesdays 10:00am PT starting 2027-06-22. If that works, can you share a Pinecone staging account and test dataset (or a reproducible data generator)?

Also cc'ing Eric from AtlasData — they're our data ingestion partner and will want to run compatibility tests (schema + chunking) as part of the verification.

Thanks — I’ll draft a Mutual Action Plan once we lock the timeline.

-Avery
Avery Johnson
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

--

From: Sara Lim <sara@pinecone.io>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vector connector governance & ops onramp

Thanks Avery — this is perfect. Quick answers inline and attached a light SOW draft (sow-draft.docx):

- SOC2: we will provide our most recent SOC2 Type II and a redacted pentest summary by EOD Monday.
- SSO/KMS: Pinecone supports SAML and OIDC for enterprise plans. CMK is available in our EU regions; US CMK roadmap is Q3. We’ll include the KMS integration diagram for your infra team.
- Staging: we can spin a dedicated staging index and provide service credentials by next Tue. We’ll also share a small synthetic dataset for reproducible perf runs.
- Perf: Our engineering team confirms we can target the latency numbers you requested. For the 50k QPS soak we recommend a canary ramp over 6 hours to validate autoscaling.
- Ops: we have a documented spillover behavior (cold-tier failover) — attaching the runbook excerpt in the checklist PDF.
- Commercials: attached is a simple rev-share template; pricing for egress varies by region — see the perf-sla-targets.xlsx.

Next steps suggested:
- Pinecone to send artifacts (SOC2, pentest redaction, KMS diagram) by 2027-06-21
- Redwood to share required legal T&Cs and a short Mutual Action Plan draft by 2027-06-21
- Kickoff sync Tues 2027-06-22 at 10am PT (calendar invite to follow)

We’ll also coordinate with Eric at AtlasData on the ingestion connector tests — they have a small schema normalization utility that should help.

Best,
Sara

--
